correctness.rationale: The m inverse branches turn covariance into log-integrals J(j). Integration by parts, Li₂(−1/j), and telescoping logs give C(m)=1+m⁻¹Σ_{j=1}^{m−1}jLi₂(−1/j), with C(1)=1. Each r_j=1+jLi₂(−1/j) has a positive decreasing integral representation; averaging establishes C(m)>0 and strict decrease. Dilogarithm expansion of r_j through j⁻³ and Euler–Maclaurin give (.25 log m+B)/m−1/(72m²)+1/(288m³)+O(m⁻⁴); independently evaluated B=1.0102793965954957… and checked high precision residuals. Lag decay O(kb⁻k) justifies absolute convergence and exact pair-count identity Var(S_N)=Nσ²−κ+2Σ_{k≥N}(k−N)C(b^k); geometric j-sum yields N b^(1−N)log b/[2(b−1)²]+O_b(b⁻N). Finite numerical quadrature and N checks are corroborative, not a proof.
